Matthew Shaw is the strongest on paper (platform and SRE, Go, runbooks, willing to take a pay cut and work in the office) and should be interviewed first.
Edward Savage and Darren Taylor are both in. Ed is a possible backfill for Nyla, but his 70k ask and quick jump to senior need probing.
The referred candidate is parked: no clear level, salary or availability, and nothing on the CV that stands out.
How many seats this round is filling is still unconfirmed.
